own: If the ad poster is the seller, then they are selling XMR, so that means they have an ad up advertising their XMR for sale. The person clicking on them, the trader, is a buyer. They are initiating the trade. With this particular method, I think the way it's going to have to work is the buyer says how much XMR they are interested in, and the seller, the one who posts the ad, is actually going to be the one who funds the escrow. Then the 10 confirmations happen, and then the buyer is going to be paying in one of the payment methods that this seller has said that they accept. So again, the time frame is going to reflect on the payment method.
